scripts.text:
[{0}]
Good day~
I'm {1}, your
guide to exploring
the Einbroch Tower.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
您好~我是 {1}，您的艾音布羅克中央塔遊覽嚮導。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Einbroch Tower offers
the best view of our city
and it's a great place to
meet with friends or take
a date. The Einbroch Tower
admission fee is 10 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
在艾音布羅克中央塔能欣賞到全城最美的風景，是朋友聚會或約會的好去處。
門票只需 10 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Right now, we're offering
a special promotion called
the Apple Combo Set for only
20 zeny. This set includes
Einbroch Tower admission
and an Apple to snack on.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
目前我們推出了特惠蘋果套餐，只需 20 Zeny，包含艾音布羅克中央塔門票和一個供您享用的蘋果。

scripts.text: Tower Admission Only
scripts.translation: 僅購買門票

scripts.text: Apple Combo Set
scripts.translation: 蘋果套餐

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm sorry, but you
don't have enough
zeny. The Einbroch
Tower Admission
fee is 10 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
很抱歉，您的 Zeny 不足。艾音布羅克中央塔的門票需要 10 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you for
using our services.
Let me guide you to
the tower right away.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
感謝您使用我們的服務。我這就帶您前往中央塔。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have enough zeny. The
Apple Combo Set is 20 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
很抱歉，您的 Zeny 不足。蘋果套餐需要 20 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Before I guide you to
the tower, let me check
your status to insure
your safety before I give
you the Apple Combo Set.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
帶您前往中央塔之前，請讓我先檢查您的狀態，確保安全後再為您提供蘋果套餐。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you for
using our services.
Let me guide you to
the tower right away.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
感謝您使用我們的服務。我這就帶您前往中央塔。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm sorry, but you're carrying
too many items with you. Please store some of your things in your Kafra Storage before purchasing
the Apple Combo Set.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
很抱歉，您攜帶的物品太多了。請先將部分物品存入卡普拉倉庫，再購買蘋果套餐。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see.
Feel free to
come back any
time. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，歡迎隨時再來。謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Morei]
Greetings,
I am Morei,
Assistant Guide
of Einbroch Tower.
scripts.translation:
[莫雷]
您好，我是莫雷，艾音布羅克中央塔的助理嚮導。

scripts.text:
[Morei]
If you wish to return
to the ground floor,
please let me know.
Would you like to go
back to ground level?
scripts.translation:
[莫雷]
如果您想回到一樓，請告訴我。您現在要下樓嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不用

scripts.text:
[Morei]
I see.
Let me lead you
to the ground floor.
Thank you for using
our services.
scripts.translation:
[莫雷]
好的，我這就帶您回到一樓。感謝您使用我們的服務。

scripts.text:
[Morei]
I see.
I hope you
enjoy your time
in Einbroch Tower.
scripts.translation:
[莫雷]
好的，祝您在艾音布羅克中央塔玩得盡興。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Welcome to
the Train Station.
Trains to Einbech
are always running
so if you miss one,
it's no problem.
scripts.translation:
[職員]
歡迎來到火車站。開往艾音貝赫的火車班次很多，錯過一班也沒關係。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
The fare to board the
train that runs the Einbroch
to Einbech line is 200 zeny.
Would you like to buy a ticket?
scripts.translation:
[職員]
從艾音布羅克開往艾音貝赫的火車，票價為 200 Zeny。您要買票嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不用

scripts.text: About the Environment...
scripts.translation: 關於環境...

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Thank you
very much.
Have a safe trip.
^333333*Ahem*^000000 All aboard!
scripts.translation:
[職員]
非常感謝。
祝您旅途平安。
^333333*咳咳*^000000 各位請上車！

scripts.text:
[Staff]
I'm sorry, but this
isn't enough zeny
to pay the train fare.
scripts.translation:
[職員]
很抱歉，您的 Zeny 不夠支付火車票價。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Very well, then.
Please enjoy your
stay in Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[職員]
好的。
祝您在艾音布羅克度過愉快的時光。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Einbroch is infamous for
its air pollution, no doubt
caused by the industrial
facilities located here.
It's really horrible...
scripts.translation:
[職員]
艾音布羅克的空氣汙染嚴重，早已臭名遠揚。這無疑是這裡的工業設施造成的。
真是糟透了...

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Sometimes the air pollution
gets so bad that it becomes
hard to breathe. If you hear
the Einbroch Smog Alert, you
should find shelter immediately!
scripts.translation:
[職員]
有時空氣汙染嚴重到讓人難以呼吸。如果聽到艾音布羅克煙霧警報，請立即找地方避難！

scripts.text:
[Leslie]
^666666*Cough cough!*^000000
Laaaand sakes!

[Leslie]
An old woman like me
can't breathe this air! How
do people even live in all this
smog? Sure, the air in Einbech
isn't pristine, but the air here in Einbroch is much worse! ^333333*Cough~!*^000000
scripts.translation:
[萊斯利]
我這把老骨頭，可受不了這樣的空氣！人們怎麼能在這麼重的煙霧裡生活？
雖然艾音貝赫的空氣也不算乾淨，但艾音布羅克這裡可差多了！^333333*咳~！*^000000

scripts.text:
[Leslie]
I hate coming here
sometimes! The air is
totally polluted and this
city is full of stuck up
pricks! But they sell stuff
here I can't buy back home...
scripts.translation:
[萊斯利]
有時候我真不想來這裡！空氣汙濁不堪，滿城還都是些傲慢的混蛋！
可這裡有些東西，在老家買不到...

scripts.text:
[Tan]
All the factories
here in Einbroch are
causing a serious air
pollution problem.
scripts.translation:
[譚]
艾音布羅克的這些工廠造成了嚴重的空氣汙染。

scripts.text:
[Tan]
I'm an Airship engineer and
everyday, all day long, I deal
with oil stains and all sorts
of pollutants. I'm surprised
I haven't gotten sick yet...
scripts.translation:
[譚]
我是飛空艇工程師，每天從早到晚都跟油汙和各種汙染物打交道。居然到現在還沒生病，連我自己都覺得奇怪...

scripts.text:
[Tan]
Still, I try to be careful
when I can. Whenever I go
out into the city's red fog,
I always wear my Flu Mask.
If you'll be here for a while,
you should carry one with you.
scripts.translation:
[譚]
不過，能小心的時候，我還是儘量小心。每次出門走進城裡的紅色煙霧，我都會戴上口罩。
如果你要在這裡待上一陣子，最好也隨身帶一個。

scripts.text:
[Little Toby]
Excuse me...
But I'm lost!
I can't find my
mom or dad!
scripts.translation:
[小 托比]
打擾一下...我迷路了！找不到爸爸媽媽了！

scripts.text:
[Little Toby]
A-am I at the Airport?!
My parents are supposed
to come get me, but I still
haven't found them! We just
moved here, so I don't know
where anything is!
scripts.translation:
[小 托比]
我...我這是在飛空艇站嗎？！爸爸媽媽應該會來接我，可我還沒找到他們！
我們剛搬來，我哪裡都不認識！

scripts.text:
[Little Toby]
W-wait!
Where are you
going?! Don't leave
me, I'm all alone...!
scripts.translation:
[小 托比]
等...等等！你要去哪裡？！別丟下我，我就一個人...！

scripts.text:
[Airship Engineer]
H-hey! Don't
touch my precious
Burielle! I just finished
her tune-up and now she's
sleeping! J-just step away!
scripts.translation:
[飛空艇工程師]
喂...喂！別碰我的寶貝布里埃爾！我剛給她除錯完，她現在正在睡覺！
快...快退後！

scripts.text: Who's Burielle?
scripts.translation: 布里埃爾是誰？

scripts.text: Sorry about That.
scripts.translation: 抱歉

scripts.text:
[Airship Engineer]
Burielle is the prettiest
model among all the Airships
made within the last ten years!
She might be grounded now, but
with my healing hands, she'll
conquer the skies again!
scripts.translation:
[飛空艇工程師]
布里埃爾是近十年來建造的飛空艇裡，最漂亮的一款！
她現在雖然停飛了，可只要有我這雙妙手，就一定能再次征服天空！

scripts.text: Ah~
scripts.translation: 啊~

scripts.text: Uh huh...
scripts.translation: 嗯嗯...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah~
I see, so you're
working on restoring
this magnificent specimen
of an Airship. Best of luck~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊~原來你正在修復這艘氣派的飛空艇。祝你順利~

scripts.text:
[Airship Engineer]
Yeah. I'd appreciate
it if you'd just be careful.
I've put a lot of love into
fixing up Burielle...
scripts.translation:
[飛空艇工程師]
沒錯。你要是能小心一點，我會很感激的。
為了修好布里埃爾，我可是傾注了不少心血...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Uh huh...
Right. For a second
there, I thought you were
talking about a person, but
then I also assumed that you
weren't, you know, a nutcase.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯嗯...好吧。剛才我還以為你在說一個人呢，不過那時我也以為你不是個瘋子來著。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, did you say,
''prettiest model?''
All Airships look the
same to me, this one
ain't special at all. You've
gone loony tunes, paley boy.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，你說“最漂亮的一款”？在我看來，飛空艇都長一個樣，這艘也沒什麼特別的。
老兄，你真是瘋了。

scripts.text:
[Airship Engineer]
Wh-what...?!
scripts.translation:
[飛空艇工程師]
什...什麼...？！

scripts.text:
[Airship Engineer]
Well, at least you know
what you did wrong. Now
quit disturbing her and git!
scripts.translation:
[飛空艇工程師]
哼，至少你知道自己錯了。別再打擾她，趕緊走！

scripts.text:
[Centzu]
I've lived here for
a long time and I see
that this huge city is still
growing bigger everyday.
scripts.translation:
[岑祖]
我在這裡住了很多年。這座城市已經這麼大了，卻還在一天比一天大。

scripts.text:
[Centzu]
How did Einbroch get so
huge so quickly? I still can't
believe there's been this much
development. Well, I suppose
it's not my concern. Nothing
I do will make a difference...
scripts.translation:
[岑祖]
艾音布羅克怎麼這麼快就發展成了大城市？變化這麼大，真讓人難以置信。
不過，想來也不關我的事。反正我做什麼都改變不了...

scripts.text:
[Centzu]
Even though such
rapid industrialization
can't be good for the
environment or the people,
I'll just sit back, watch what
happens and just enjoy life...
scripts.translation:
[岑祖]
工業化這麼快，對環境和居民肯定沒好處。不過，我還是坐在一旁看看會發生什麼，過好自己的日子就行了...

scripts.text:
[Khowropher]
^666666*Cough cough*^000000
Jiminy! The air here
is so thick and grimy!
And it's worse for us old
people with breathing
problems! ^333333*Haaack!*^000000
scripts.translation:
[科羅弗]
^666666*咳咳*^000000
天哪！這裡的空氣又嗆又髒！我們這些呼吸不好的老人就更受不了了！^333333*咳啊！*^000000

scripts.text:
[Khowropher]
I don't care if they keep
building more and more
factories and homes in this
town. Still, I'd like to spend
the rest of my life somewhere
quiet and with clean air...
scripts.translation:
[科羅弗]
他們愛在城裡蓋多少工廠、多少房子，我都不在乎。我只想找個安靜、空氣乾淨的地方，度過餘生...

scripts.text:
[Khowropher]
Then again, Einbroch is my
hometown and I can't just up
and leave. I suppose it's my
fate to suffer from this foul air until the day I die. ^666666*Sigh...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[科羅弗]
可艾音布羅克畢竟是我的家鄉，我也不能說走就走。看來，我命中註定要忍受這汙濁的空氣，直到死的那一天。^666666*唉...*^000000

scripts.text:
[Khetine]
Lately, there's been
talk about this empty
building downtown that's
been converted into some
sort of mysterious facility.
scripts.translation:
[凱蒂娜]
最近，大家都在議論，市中心有棟空樓被改成了某種神秘設施。

scripts.text:
[Khetine]
It all seems pretty
shady, but I guess it's
not really my job to know
about that. I mean, if it
doesn't affect me, why
should I be concerned?
scripts.translation:
[凱蒂娜]
聽起來挺可疑的，不過，我想這也不是我該管的事。
只要不影響我，我幹嗎操心呢？

scripts.text:
[Sleik]
Surprisingly, we have
a Train Station that everyone
has been calling a victory for
science. I mean, shouldn't we
be more amazed by the Airship?
scripts.translation:
[斯萊克]
真奇怪，我們有了火車站，大家就都說這是科學的勝利。可飛空艇不是更值得驚歎嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sleik]
Now, if you want to know
where the train actually goes,
I wouldn't be able to tell you.
After all, I never rode it. But
still, I guess having our own
Train Station is a good thing.
scripts.translation:
[斯萊克]
你要問火車究竟開往哪裡，我可答不上來。畢竟，我從來沒坐過。
不過，有自己的火車站，總歸是件好事。

scripts.text:
[Runnan]
...And that's why
I travel around the
globe. My bosses have
a keen eye for the most
exotic goods, so I acquire
them and make deliveries.
scripts.translation:
[魯南]
...所以我才要滿世界跑。老闆們專挑最稀奇的貨物，我就負責採購，再把貨送過去。

scripts.text:
[Runnan]
There even was a time
when they had me collect
Jellopy, though that stuff is
pretty common nowadays.
Now that I think about it, why
did they need so much stuff?
scripts.translation:
[魯南]
有一陣子，他們甚至讓我收集傑勒比結晶，雖然這東西現在挺常見的。
現在想想，他們要那麼多東西幹什麼呢？

scripts.text:
[Zhen Lan]
Now, I hear that the
monsters around here
carry around some ore
that dazzles with a sublimely
beautiful light. Neat, huh?
scripts.translation:
[真嵐]
聽說這裡的魔物身上帶著一種礦石，會閃耀出極其美麗的光芒。挺不錯吧？

scripts.text:
[Zhen Lan]
These ores are a great
material to use in making
flower vases. My friend, who
happens to be a doll maker,
told me that. He makes these dolls using all sorts of materials.
scripts.translation:
[真嵐]
這些礦石是製作花瓶的好材料。這是我一個做玩偶的朋友告訴我的。
他做玩偶時，什麼材料都會用。

scripts.text:
[Zhen Lan]
He fashions them out of
Well-Tanned Leather, stuffs
them with Bird Feathers, and
uses Cyfar or Zargon to make
the eyes. He even uses a Jellopy at the bottom to balance the doll.
scripts.translation:
[真嵐]
他用鞣製皮革做外皮，用羽毛填充，再用賽依伐或剎勒空結晶做眼睛。甚至還會在底部放一顆傑勒比結晶，讓玩偶保持平衡。

scripts.text:
[Zhen Lan]
I guess that goes to show
that things that seem useless
might actually be handy in some
way. So don't worry about having too much stuff. Sooner or later, it might be useful to someone.
scripts.translation:
[真嵐]
看來，看似沒用的東西，其實也可能派上用場。
所以，東西多也別發愁，遲早會有人用得上。

scripts.text:
[Teinz]
If you just pay me money,
I'll be your slave! There's
nothing I won't do! Anything
is fair game. Hell, I'll get buck naked if you pay me enough.
scripts.translation:
[泰因茨]
只要給錢，我就當你的奴隸！沒什麼是我不肯做的，什麼都行！
媽的，只要錢給夠，讓我脫個精光都沒問題。

scripts.text:
[Teinz]
If you pay me what I'm
worth, I'll work hard at
any task you set me to.
Sure, mining's rough, but
as long as the zeny's coming
in, I'm happy. Heh heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[泰因茨]
只要報酬對得起我的付出，你交代什麼活，我都會賣力幹。
挖礦是辛苦，可只要 Zeny 不斷進賬，我就開心。嘿嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Lowe]
Hey. Why are you
looking at me like
that? There's no idle
chatting allowed at work.
If Canphotii catches
you, you'll be punished...
scripts.translation:
[洛威]
喂，你幹嗎這樣看著我？工作時不許閒聊。
要是被坎福蒂逮著，你會受罰的...

scripts.text:
[Lowe]
Oh wait...
You don't work here.
I apologize, that kind
of reaction's an old
habit for me, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[洛威]
哦，等等...你不是這裡的工人。
抱歉，冒險者，我習慣這樣說話了。

scripts.text:
[Dinje]
Do you know why a woman
like me has to work in this
factory? I'll tell you why...
scripts.translation:
[丁傑]
你知道我一個女人，為什麼非得在這工廠裡幹活嗎？我告訴你...

scripts.text:
[Dinje]
My lazy husband, Gesin,
is just lying there on the
ground! So I have to work
in order to support us!
scripts.translation:
[丁傑]
我那個懶鬼丈夫格辛，就在那邊地上躺著！我只好出來幹活，養活我們兩個！

scripts.text:
[Dinje]
We can't rest for even
a second if we want to save
enough money to become
wealthy and powerful some
day. Don't you understand?
scripts.translation:
[丁傑]
要攢夠錢，將來過上有錢有勢的日子，就一刻都不能歇著。你明白嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dinje]
Well, my husband obviously
doesn't! How can he not know
how the real world works?!
Hey, kick his ass for me if
he doesn't wake up soon!
scripts.translation:
[丁傑]
我那丈夫顯然不明白！他怎麼連世道是怎麼回事都不懂？！
喂，要是他還不起來，就替我揍他一頓！

scripts.text:
[Tsuen]
There was a time
when I dreamed of
being an adventurer,
just like you. But that
was a long time ago...
scripts.translation:
[翠恩]
我也曾夢想著像你一樣當個冒險者。不過，那已經是很久以前的事了...

scripts.text:
[Tsuen]
Now, I'm nothing but
a factory manager. Still,
even if my job's not that
great, I'm pretty satisfied.
I'm sure people enjoy the
products I oversee and all...
scripts.translation:
[翠恩]
如今，我只是個工廠管理員。不過，這工作雖然不怎麼了不起，我也挺滿足的。
我想，人們一定喜歡我負責生產的那些產品...

scripts.text:
[Tsuen]
Maybe my life was meant
to be this way, even if it's
not how I planned it. But the
time will come when I up and
leave and travel the world
once I get my chance!
scripts.translation:
[翠恩]
也許我這輩子註定如此，雖然跟當初的打算不同。
不過，總有一天，只要機會來了，我就會離開這裡，去環遊世界！

scripts.text:
[Tsuen]
I hope the day will
come when I can meet
you out in that big wide
world and greet you as
a fellow adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[翠恩]
希望有一天，能在外面廣闊的世界裡遇見你，以冒險者同伴的身份向你打招呼。

scripts.text:
[Gesin]
Arrrgh!
This is killing me!
Why should I be rich?
What's wrong with living
within our means?
scripts.translation:
[格辛]
啊啊！真要命！幹嗎非得有錢不可？量入為出地過日子，有什麼不好？

scripts.text:
[Gesin]
I've got no problem
with my current way
of life, but the old ball
and chain disagrees.
Why is she so obsessed
with riches and power?
scripts.translation:
[格辛]
我覺得現在的日子挺好，可我老婆偏不同意。她怎麼就那麼痴迷於錢和權勢呢？

scripts.text:
[Gesin]
Well, in any case, I'd
like to help her, but I can't
get up! I'm exhausted and
my body is just overtaxed.
I have no strength at all.
scripts.translation:
[格辛]
不管怎麼說，我也想幫她，可我根本起不來！我已經累壞了，身體吃不消，一點力氣都沒有。

scripts.text:
[Gesin]
This is horrible~
I should be resting
instead of worrying
about making money...
scripts.translation:
[格辛]
真受不了~我該好好休息，哪還有心思操心賺錢...

scripts.text:
[Pevtatin]
Good god!
I'm so stressed!
It's been nonstop
since I moved here!
scripts.translation:
[佩夫塔廷]
天哪！壓力太大了！從搬來這裡開始，就一直沒消停過！

scripts.text:
[Pevtatin]
The work is tough and
already the boss hates
me! I didn't move here
for this! Still, the pay is
decent so I guess I should
endure just a little longer.
scripts.translation:
[佩夫塔廷]
活又苦又累，老闆還已經看我不順眼了！我可不是為了過這種日子才搬來的！
不過，工資還不錯，還是再忍一陣子吧。

scripts.text:
[Pevtatin]
Here goes...!
Yo-heave-ho!
Yo-heave-ho~!
scripts.translation:
[佩夫塔廷]
開始幹活了...！
嘿咻——嘿咻！
嘿咻——嘿咻~！

scripts.text:
[Rombell]
It's great that the
factory is making good
business and drawing
in a lot of profit, but I still
have one major concern.
scripts.translation:
[羅姆貝爾]
工廠生意興隆，賺了不少錢，當然是好事。可我還是有件特別擔心的事。

scripts.text:
[Rombell]
The amount of pollution
that this place is causing
is horrific! We've got these
machines blowing out toxic
gas all day long! The air
can't be safe for very long...
scripts.translation:
[羅姆貝爾]
這裡造成的汙染實在可怕！這些機器整天排放有毒氣體，空氣恐怕很快就會危害健康了...

scripts.text:
[Rombell]
I mean, the air we're
breathing right now is
pretty foul and things
are only going to get
worse. How can we
solve this problem?
scripts.translation:
[羅姆貝爾]
我們現在呼吸的空氣已經很汙濁了，往後只會更糟。這個問題究竟該怎麼解決呢？

scripts.text:
[Vonstein]
Staring at this
bubbling hot liquid
metal gives me a good
feeling inside. It's like
that stuff can melt anything!
scripts.translation:
[馮斯坦]
看著這些滾燙的金屬液咕嘟冒泡，我心裡就特別舒坦。感覺它們能把什麼都熔掉！

scripts.text:
[Vonstein]
Imagine covering an
entire street of people
with that stuff! Bwahah--
Oh, I'm sorry if I'm talking
crazy talk! I'm just kidding~
scripts.translation:
[馮斯坦]
想像一下，把這東西澆在整條街的人身上！哇哈哈——
哦，抱歉，我是不是說瘋話了？開個玩笑而已~

scripts.text:
[Dorf]
Machines are sooo
convenient. Just look
at this contraption easily
do tasks that'd be tough
for me to finish alone.
scripts.translation:
[多夫]
機器真是方便啊。你看，這個裝置輕輕鬆鬆就能幹完那些我一個人很難完成的活。

scripts.text:
[Dorf]
Now this is what
I call technology!
Sure, it takes effort and
money to make one of
these, but what do I care?
scripts.translation:
[多夫]
這才叫技術！造這麼一臺機器，當然要費錢費力，可那關我什麼事？

scripts.text:
[Dorf]
I've got no problems,
so long as this freaking
thing keeps working the
way I want it to!
scripts.translation:
[多夫]
只要這玩意兒能按我的要求一直運轉，我就沒什麼好抱怨的！

scripts.text:
[Khashurantze]
I'm sorry, but you need
special authority in order
to enter this place. I'll have
to ask you to leave right now.
scripts.translation:
[卡舒蘭策]
很抱歉，進入此地需要特殊許可權。請您立刻離開。

scripts.text:
[Zherin]
I'm in charge of this
blast furnace which
contains all of this
boiling magma.
scripts.translation:
[澤林]
我負責管理這座高爐，裡面裝滿了沸騰的岩漿。

scripts.text:
[Zherin]
Even though it doesn't
require actual labor, this
job is pretty tiring. I've got
to pay careful attention all
the time. It's pretty stressful.
scripts.translation:
[澤林]
雖然不用幹體力活，但這份工作還是很累。得時刻集中注意力，壓力不小。

scripts.text:
[Zherin]
Still, I'm proud of my job
since I have the responsibility
of ensuring employee safety.
Anyway, don't get too close
to the furnace. It won't do if
you get burned on accident!
scripts.translation:
[澤林]
不過，能負責保障員工的安全，我為這份工作感到自豪。
總之，別離高爐太近，萬一不小心燒傷了可就不好了！

scripts.text:
[Canphotii]
Hustle, hustle!
Pick up the pace!
Anyone working too
slowly will be punished!
scripts.translation:
[坎福蒂]
快點，快點！動作麻利點！誰幹活太慢，誰就要受罰！

scripts.text:
[Canphotii]
Can't you understand
that?! Now go to your
station and get back to
work! Wait, are you even
an employee? If not, then
stop wandering around!
scripts.translation:
[坎福蒂]
聽不明白嗎？！現在就回崗位上幹活！
等等，你是這裡的員工嗎？不是就別在這兒亂晃！

scripts.text:
[Canphotii]
You're not supposed
to be able to get in here!
I can't believe they let you
in! This requires extreme
disciplinary action!
scripts.translation:
[坎福蒂]
你不該進得來這裡！真不敢相信他們竟然放你進來了！必須嚴加處分！

scripts.text:
[Cendadt]
This factory has a lot
of things that need fixing,
pronto! I'm amazed that
the place is still operating!
scripts.translation:
[岑達特]
這工廠好多地方都急著要修！它竟然還能運轉，真叫人吃驚！

scripts.text:
[Cendadt]
Lucky for us, I hear that
some altruistic adventurers
have been donating materials
to help keep this factory from
falling apart... Or worse.
But that's just a rumor.
scripts.translation:
[岑達特]
幸好，聽說有些熱心的冒險者一直在捐材料，幫忙防止這工廠垮掉...或發生更糟的事。
不過，這也只是傳聞。

scripts.text:
[Cendadt]
^666666*Sigh*^000000
Even if it is true,
there's nothing no one
here can do. Nobody has
the courage to challenge
the system, you know?
scripts.translation:
[岑達特]
^666666*唉*^000000
就算是真的，我們這裡的人也無能為力。沒人敢挑戰這套制度，你懂吧？

scripts.text:
[Cendadt]
I...
I better get
back to work
before I get
in trouble...
scripts.translation:
[岑達特]
我...我還是趕緊回去幹活吧，免得惹上麻煩...
